prompt: The W and H fields should accept units: in, pt and px, and % of the frame the layer is in (W takes the frame's width, H its height). For example 2in is 192 px and 18pt is 24 px. Arithmetic keeps working and can mix units, so 1in + 4 gives 100. A % value on a layer that is not inside a frame is refused and changes nothing. The other fields keep working as they do now.
reference: Adds a unit-aware mode to the expression parser the panel uses, reads typed text once per node with the nearest frame as the % reference, and leaves parseLength as it was.

naive.summary: Follows Proof: teaches parseLength (which Proof names as the panel parser) to read units and tries it before the expression parser, so a unit inside arithmetic is refused.
